# Between Stops site

> The public website for Between Stops, a private iPhone and Android app that shows the small tasks you have put off which fit the few minutes you have. The apps also cover Apple Watch and Wear OS. It holds the app's privacy policy and its contact and support page, in English. Static HTML and CSS served by GitHub Pages, with no scripts, forms, cookies or analytics. MIT licensed.

Key facts:

- Live site: https://caputodavide93.github.io/between-stops-site/
- Privacy policy: https://caputodavide93.github.io/between-stops-site/privacy/
- What the privacy policy says about the app: no account, no servers, no analytics, ads or tracking, no AI. Tasks, places and settings stay on the phone, and iOS and Android backup of that data is switched off. Only a file the user chooses to export or send leaves the phone. The app is free, with no purchases, tips or ads.
- Read the policy itself for the exact wording and its effective date; this summary is not a substitute.
- Contact and support page: https://caputodavide93.github.io/between-stops-site/contact/ (the support address is on that page).
- Built from plain files: one index.html per page, one shared stylesheet with light and dark colours. No build step.
- Tested: layout and screenshots in Chromium on macOS, light and dark. Safari, Firefox and screen readers are unverified.
- Preview and check locally: `make serve`, then `make check` (needs Python 3).
- Trade-off: pages are English only, and GitHub Pages may keep standard server logs.
- Independent project by Davide Caputo.
